svg.textArea: Signal-led outbound design v0.2, built from context/icp and context/docs/gtm-system.md. Work in progress.
svg.text: 2 Find people and write the message

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, research

1B Buying signals
• Payments, fraud, treasury hiring
• SaaS launching payments
• New country expansion
• New commerce platform

1E Enrich
Size, revenue, HQ, stack, PSPs in job posts

1M Pick angle
• New country: expansion
• 2+ PSPs: consolidation
• Else: segment angle

2A Find people
• Head of Payments first
• Else CFO, or CPO for SaaS
• CTO on replatform

2F Write and QA copy
Spec, copy, QA against spec

3A Sequence
• 6 touches, 14 days
• Email in PlusVibe
• LinkedIn tasks in HubSpot

3B Classify reply
Webhook, AI step, SDR acts in 1 day

3D Weekly metrics
Reply, bounce, meetings, cost per meeting

3E Weekly review
Kill, promote or clone signals; update ICP
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
